lines.en: label mollydate35p1:
scene bedroom_day
Morning comes.
And I receive a phone call.
: Hel-
: Bal'a dash, malanore! Doral ana'diel?
: Sorry, wrong number.
: How goes it, Sir? How fares thee?
: I would have liked to have slept a little longer before being woken up by whatever your language is called again.
: Irish. Or Gaelic. Technically Irish, but only because the damn Scots stole Gaelic and we just keeled over and let ‘em.
: But what I was speaking just now was actually Thalassian- the language of the blood elves. Selama ashal'anore! Justice for our people!
: Why are you calling me?
: Because I refuse to have our rank drop down again just because you’re not attracted to me!
: Also, I require aid- for my quest today is significantly harder without someone there to support me and the Kendo Princess has other matters she must tend to.
: I don’t-
: Anar'alah, Sir! Act ‘yer feckin’ age! The Supreme Overlord I know isn’t perturbed by the presence of teenage girls! He steals their life force and converts it into mana!
: So we had an awkward night! Big deal! Every night is awkward when you’re me and you’ll never survive in the outside world if you can’t come to terms with that!
: You are probably the last person I want to lecture me on how to survive in the outside world.
: Well, stop making amateur mistakes and I won’t have to keep bringing up tooltips! You did this to yourself!
: How quickly can you make it to Silvermoon?
: I...have no idea where that even is.
: Eversong Woods, just north of the East Sanctum.
: Are we traveling to an alternate dimension?
: God, I wish. An isekai is exactly what I need right now. Preferably one where I’m extremely overpowered and have an entire harem at my disposal.
: Sounds exhausting.
: You would know, Sir. So, can you make it to the Entertainment District within the hour? Or should I open a portal to your home and retrieve you along the way?
: I can head over...but I’m still not sure if-
: Excellent! Shorel'aran, Sir! I’ll see you soon!
: ...that’s a good idea.
scene sky
Molly hangs up the phone and, despite the sudden return of my uneasiness when it comes to being around her (Thanks, Haruka), I get dressed and start heading over to “Silvermoon.”
It’s annoying, though. Things were going completely fine until the invisible girl-magnet inside of me started pulling Molly over. And it’s annoying that I’m so aware of that as well.
I want more than anything to return to the blissfully ignorant me who would have fucked her on Haruka’s couch prior to our dramatic fallout two Halloweens ago.
I want to see her the way she wants me to see her...and carry through with those lust-driven ideas I proposed to her way back when.
scene lavendersgreen6
But all I can see when I’m alone with her is this.
scene mollydressingroom1
: Greetings, Sir! Thank you for clearing out some room in your quest journal. Your assistance is invaluable and I appreciate you in an entirely platonic, not-at-all sexually driven way!
: Okay, I guess we’re already going there.
: Not at all, Sir! You made your stance loud and clear last night! And the new and improved Molly MacCormack has taken several precautions to ensure she doesn’t make you uncomfortable again!
: Well, you’re off to a pretty rocky start. So, what are we doing? Why did you need me?
: I need your help trying on clothes.
: Mission failed.
scene mollydressingroom2
: Geh! The worst words any gamer could ever hear!
scene mollydressingroom3
: ...is what I would be saying if I wasn’t a genius who had already taken that into consideration!
: I’m listening...
: The fact that you are so wholly opposed to physical contact with me at this point makes you the perfect dressing room partner, Sir!
: We’re here on strictly business! We’ve eliminated the risk for lewd behavior and are free to focus purely on making me the best Molly I can be!
: Is that “best Molly” just normal Molly dressed up as and pretending to be someone else?
scene mollydressingroom4
: Exactly! I knew calling upon you as my backup was the right choice, Sir.
: Even if any of that is true, you seem to be forgetting the part where I am an adult male and you are a young girl. No one is going to let me into a dressing room with you.
scene mollydressingroom5
: They will if we’re dating.
: Molly-
: Hear me out-
: I’m trying to. But it seems like every single step you’re taking to make things less weird is somehow making them more weird.
: If tact and subtlety will not work, which they never seem to for me, I must change directions entirely! Now come, dalah'surfal!
: And what does “dalah'surfal” mean, exactly?
: Lover.
: I’m going home.
scene mollydressingroom6
: Fine. I’ll just have to ask some random person off the street if they want to follow me into a dressing room and take my clothes off. I’m sure that will work out perfectly.
: The fact that you’re not worried about me is perhaps the most concerning element of all of this.
scene mollydressingroom7
: Sir, you have seen me in ways more intimate than anyone.
: You have caught me with my pants down, you’ve rejected my advances, and you’ve ejaculated on me.
: I do not care at this point if you see me in my underwear. Especially when you have no desire to touch me.
: This is so weird.
: What’s weird is how weird you’re making it. How messed up do things have to get for me to be the one trying to normalize them?
: We’re friends, aren’t we? Just help me zip some zippers and tie some bows. It’s not like I’m asking you to bend me over a stack of props and spank me ‘til my arse is red.
: But what if I-
: I trust you, Sir. And I highly, highly doubt you will do anything to hurt me.
scene mollydressingroom8
: But, on the off chance you do, I consent to everything. Now, no one has to feel guilty if anything does happen.
: What did Haruka say to you after I left last night?
scene mollydressingroom9
: Nothing. But, if she happens to ask about anything missing from her closet, I was never there.
: What did-
: That’s for me to know and you to be entirely disinterested in, Sir.
scene mollydressingroom10
: Now, then! Shall we go, dalah'surfal?
: Fine. But I’m staying ten feet away at all times when I don’t have to “zip zippers or tie bows.”
: Look at that! Substantial character development in one measly conversation! Turns out dumping points into speech does help after all!
scene black
Molly subsequently drags me into several stores, each one specializing in different types of paraphernelia- whether it be wigs, makeup, or materials.
scene mollydressingroom11
But it isn’t until we make it to the fourth store that I’m put on the spot, as this one seems to specialize in premade costumes.

Which means of course, that in a matter of minutes, I’m going to be behind closed doors with a girl I have a history of preying upon in a...way I’ve decided is less acceptable than the way I prey upon others.
It’s a little confusing considering that Molly is essentially lying on her back with her legs up at this point in an act of pure submission-
But it doesn’t change the way I feel.
I wish it would.
But it doesn’t.
And I’m not sure what (if anything) will.
: Anything in particular you’d like to see me in, Sir? Ami has informed me of an affinity you seem to have for Sailor Scouts and I must say I make an excellent Venus.
: I have no idea what Ami is talking about and you should never listen to anything she says because it is probably just an attempt to sabotage you in some way.
: A true yandere in the making, it seems. But will it be she who crosses the line first? Or will someone else put their foot down before her?
: Probably Ami. I can’t see anyone else ever going that crazy.
: Not even the likes of Noriko? Or maybe a hidden candidate like Sana or Miss Watabe?
: Miss Watabe is in a committed relationship with a girl who could kick my ass. And despite recent occurrences, I still believe Sana is an angel.
: I see you’ve yet to refuse Noriko.
: Noriko will probably just cry and masturbate.
scene mollydressingroom12
: I knew I liked her.
: Just pick whatever you want. I don’t really care.
: Maybe avoid things with too many zippers or ties, though.
scene mollydressingroom13
: Hmm...I guess that rules out anything Square Enix has ever touched...
scene black
: Oh! I know!
: This way, Sir. I’ve been here before. I know where I’m going.
: I am somehow not surprised.
Molly proceeds to grab several costumes off of the racks, never checking the sizes of anything as I’m sure she probably wants to make adjustments to them anyway.
After her hands are full, she tosses everything she picked up to me as this is apparently the job I signed up for before going out of her way to grab even more.
I have no idea how long she anticipates this ordeal taking but, based on the amount of clothes we’re both holding and how complicated they all appear to be-
I think we’ll probably be ready to leave by sometime next month.
scene mollydressingroom14
: Hmm...
: Sir, based on visuals alone, do I strike you as the more innocent type? Or do I come across as a more...closet-pervert type of character? I’m branching out from the chuuni stuff, you see.
: I know too much about you to not take into account the type of person you actually are, which is 100%% a pervert. No closet involved.
: I said visuals only, Sir. Stop metagaming.
: I just told you I can’t do visuals alone. I’ve seen too much.
scene mollydressingroom15
: Oh well. I’ll just have to try everything.
: Everything? You grabbed like fifty outfits.
scene mollydressingroom16
: And I grabbed them for a reason. You don’t go shopping with-
scene mollydressingroom17
: Hey! I get that you’re not attracted to me, but isn’t it a little rude to shield your eyes when I’m taking my clothes off?
: Wouldn’t it be more rude to not do that? You made me turn around the last time you got dressed, didn’t you?
: Yeah, but that was well before you busted a load all over my most expensive cosplay to-date. Now, I’m just offended.
: Just tell me when you need zipper assistance. I’ll stay like this in the meantime.
scene mollydressingroom18
: Hah...how are you supposed to judge my cosplays if you won’t even look at me?
: Is “girl in underwear” one of your cosplays?
: Sir, that’s like 10%% of all cosplays. Sex sells and you should know that better than anyone as the lead character in an H-game.
: Or at least the former lead character in an H-game. Right now, you seem like every other dense harem protagonist out there.
: I’ll look at you when you’re finished getting dressed. Doing it now would be...trouble.
: Ooooh? What kind of trouble, Sir? Are you actually attracted to me after all?
: I’ve been telling you this whole time that I am. Why is that so hard to believe?
: Maybe it has something to do with the fact that you are not seizing this extremely precious opportunity to see me in the truest of my elements.
: I’m good. But thanks.
scene mollydressingroom19
: Fine! But don’t come cryin’ to me years down the line when you’re missing one CG and have to play the whole damn game all over! A true completionist would watch me get dressed!
: And then...probably do other things to me as well! But I will admit that I am less prepared for that now than I was half an hour ago!
: Are you dressed yet?
scene mollydressingroom20
: Yes. I am.
scene mollydressingroom21
: Great. Then-
: Was that so hard?
scene mollydressingroom22
: Not really. But I’m going to keep doing this anyway.
: Guh. The old you was much better at boostin’ my confidence, Sir. This one just makes me feel like a gremlin.
scene black
Molly stops pestering me to stare at her in her underwear and I do a mostly-successful job at judging her cosplays as time goes on.
The reason I say “mostly-successful” is that I give essentially the same feedback for all of them — cute. Or hot.
Or both cute and hot.
But despite how limited those descriptions are, she seems to go along with it and thanks me for my assistance each time.
Most of the bows on her outfits come pre-tied, but there are several zippers I need to help with. Thankfully, she remains steady enough that I never really come into contact with her flesh.
Which is good because I’d be lying right now if I said I wasn’t extremely tempted to take advantage of her “consent to everything” pass from earlier.
I’m just as unsafe in here as I thought I’d be.
: Okay...last one, but...
: This is, uhh...
: This one’s a little embarrassing...
scene mollydressingroom23
I am even more unsafe in here than I thought I’d be.
: The skirt on this one is a little...shorter than I expected it to be...
: So much so that I should probably just skip the turning-around part of the modeling phase.
: You’re nervous in a short skirt but...not your underwear?
scene mollydressingroom24
: Well...yes! I’m sure it sounds strange to you, but being in an outfit like this where you’re not supposed to see those parts of me is way more embarrassing than being in one where you are!
: I don’t get it.
: Neither do I, but that’s just how it is! And it also doesn’t help that I have a great deal of inappropriate artwork of this character saved on my computer!
: Well, it’s...cute.
: And hot.
scene mollydressingroom25
: Where would it rank compared to the other outfits I wore today?
: I’m trying to coordinate what our next group cosplay should be, but I didn’t want to go through with making a whole costume from scratch for something that might not work for all of us.
: I’d put all of them in whatever the highest tier is. But I think I just have a thing for costumes, so...
scene mollydressingroom26
: That doesn’t really help me much, Sir.
: I didn’t think it would. But frankly, I can’t see how Tsuneyo would have been any better at this.

: She’s more or less just as helpful as you are. But the added benefit of bringing Tsuneyo is that I get to dress her up as well. And I have a sneaking suspicion you wouldn’t let me take your clothes off.
: I have a sneaking suspicion that doing that would be a horrible decision, Molly.
scene mollydressingroom27
: R-Really?...
: But things went perfectly fine with you watching me...
: Except I didn’t really watch you. And it’s significantly harder to conceal certain parts of my body when I am not wearing pants.
: I...don’t mind.
: I’ve seen enough of them in porn to...not be bothered by that kind of stuff. And I think dressing you up would be really fun...
: That is the complete opposite of what your cheeks are saying. Also, I don’t “dress up.” If I’m taking my clothes off, it’s for one reason. Well, two counting bathing.
scene mollydressingroom28
: That said, Sir...
: Would you mind maybe...helping me take this costume off?
: What happened to entirely platonic and not-at-all sexually driven?
: I’m a pervert, Sir. I tried.
: Did you really, though?
: For a little while. This was more exciting than I thought it was going to be.
: It wasn’t horrible, though...was it?
: You seem like you’re still doing fine...and I’m...
scene mollydressingroom29
: Also fine...
: You don’t look fine.
: I’m not fine.
: I should go.
scene mollydressingroom30
: Sir-
: It wasn’t horrible. You’re right. And under different circumstances, I’m sure we’d be doing something completely different right now.
: So, then...what’s the-
: I just need a little more time, Molly.
: But if you keep being this annoying and pushy and forcing me into situations where you know I’m going to get turned on, it might not be as much time as I currently expect.
scene mollydressingroom31
: That wasn’t...exactly my intention. Just a positive side effect that I thought might happen if I got lucky.
: Well, you did. But now I’m going to step out because I am still grappling with the basics of self-control and don’t want all of my excruciating efforts to have been for nothing.
: Aye aye, Sir...
: I’m sorry I keep doing things that make you want to run away.
: Don’t be.
scene black
: Because I can assure you that you’re doing even more to pull me forward...
$ mollydate35p1 = True
$ molly_love += 1
Molly’s affection has increased to [molly_love]!
jump mollydate35p2
